name: sk-citation-chip
title: Citation Chip
description: An inline source marker sized to sit inside a sentence without breaking its rhythm, with a fixed minimum width so one- and two-digit citations do not jitter the line. Tapping opens a popover rather than pushing a screen, and stays a popover on iPhone.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKCitationChip(index: 1, source: source)
SKCitationChip(source: source, style: .domain)
